subject: prd/read-to-rule
statement: The §0 fine print: exact block wording (incl. per-block honest-zero forms), the cap value, ranked-call bounds, tier applicability details, the capture-line format (incl. the one-line-per-review-event shape and staged-gate reading), and the amendment-op mechanics for §0 — how typed ops address a section outside the ID namespaces, for maintenance and for introducing a §0 into a pre-§0 ledger (who authors and ranks over a historic ledger); plus the capture line's home relative to the review-feedback-capture ledger (prd:review-feedback-capture) — federate via its cross-citation grammar, or stay a sign-off-surface line (brainstorm:gate-attention#P-1)
